requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map and form. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to technical offices or external maintainers) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports anonymous reporting, multi-channel notifications (platform, email, Telegram bot), internal collaboration between staff and external maintainers, public/private statistics, and administrative configuration of roles and automatic assignment rules.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state; Rejected reports require an explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Possible report statuses: Pending Approval, Assigned, In Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved.
After approval, accepted reports immediately become visible on the Participium portal (map and table).
Unregistered users can view reports on maps and search by address; previously only authenticated users could view them.
An anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map of reports for citizens.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public Relation officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and should have their own individual account.
Case 1 (External maintainer has access): Comments/information exchanged between technical office and external maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Case 2 (External maintainer does not have access): Communication is out of scope; technical office updates status externally.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
Notifications/messages can be set to either be sent in real time or when the page is refreshed, depending on user preference.
Citizens can upload a personal photo and their Telegram username in the configuration panel.
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can also be used for login.
Specific technical offices must be set up; categories mapped to offices must be documented.
edge_cases: User attempts to submit a report without registering: System blocks submission until registration confirmation.
Confirmation code expires (30 minutes): User cannot activate account with expired code.
Citizen tries to modify/delete an existing report: System denies action.
Report rejected without explanation: System enforces mandatory explanation field before saving rejection.
External maintainer attempts to view internal comments from technical office staff: System hides reserved comments.
User zooms out on map: System groups reports cumulatively showing total count.
User zooms in on map: System separates reports showing title and reporter name (or 'anonymous').
Citizen tries to follow a closed report: System prevents following action.
Admin configures auto-assignment but no technical office is set for a category: System behavior undefined or defaults to manual assignment until configured.
Telegram bot command executed without Telegram username configured: Bot may prompt for setup or ignore command depending on implementation.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central administrative body responsible for initial report verification.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires a valid Telegram username configured in the user's profile to function fully.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' reporters in statistics are calculated based on volume of reports submitted by each reporter.
External maintainers added by the administrator are treated as distinct roles with specific permissions (Case 1) or excluded from the system entirely (Case 2).
The map layer is strictly OpenStreetMap standard layer unless overridden by future requirements.
Real-time vs. refresh-based notifications depend on a user preference setting stored in the configuration panel.

api_summary.summary: A citizen reporting platform API supporting user registration, verification, login, and logout. Citizens can create reports with images, view categories, and update their profiles. Municipality officers are created by admins and assigned roles. Tech leads assign officers to reports and manage agents. The system includes chat messaging for specific report contexts, notifications management, and public endpoints for viewing accepted reports and static image serving.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to register with my name and username So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute registration for a new citizen user. Provide valid name, username, and email. Verify account creation success and return of temporary verification token or status indicating pending verification.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Core onboarding flow; validates user creation without authentication.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to confirm my registration with a code So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit verification code received during registration. Ensure token matches the one issued in PT01 setup. Verify account status transitions to 'active' or equivalent.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 (register) first to obtain verification token
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify account is active; no resource deletion required.
strategy_items.rationale: Critical state transition from pending to active user.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a system administrator I want to set up municipality users
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user account via admin endpoint. Provide valid username, email, and role assignment data. Verify successful creation and return of user ID.
setup_needed: Ensure admin authentication token is present
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created user account if test fails or cleanup flag is set.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates admin capability to provision internal staff.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a system administrator I want to assign roles to municipality users
strategy_items.prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'technical_office') to an existing municipality user. Verify role assignment succeeds and user permissions update accordingly.
setup_needed: Create a municipality user via PT02 or equivalent
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Revoke role assignment or delete user if test fails.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates role management functionality for staff.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a technical office staff member I want to assign reports to external maintainers So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign an existing report (from PT05) to an external maintainer. Provide valid maintainer ID and assignment details. Verify assignment succeeds and report metadata updates.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report via PT05 to have a valid reportId
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Revoke assignment or delete report if test fails.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates cross-role collaboration and external maintainer assignment.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As an external maintainer I want to update the status of a report assigned to me So that I can updated citizens about the intervention.
strategy_items.prompt: Update the status of a previously assigned report (from PT24) to 'in_progress' or 'completed'. Verify status change is persisted and visible to authorized users.
setup_needed: Assign report via PT24 to establish valid reportId
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Revert status change or delete report if test fails.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates external maintainer workflow and status updates.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform So that I can communicate directly about my report.
strategy_items.prompt: Send a reply message within an existing chat thread (chatId derived from report). Ensure authenticated citizen session. Verify message is appended to thread and visible to operators.
setup_needed: Create a report via PT05 to establish chat context
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete sent message or archive chat if test fails.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates citizen communication channel within the platform.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen/unregistered user I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Retrieve paginated list of public reports. Apply optional filters (e.g., status, category). Verify response includes report summaries and filter logic works correctly for unauthenticated users.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates public-facing report discovery and filtering.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to provide details for my report So that the the problem is classified correctly.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report with invalid category value (e.g., 'unknown_category'). Verify system rejects submission with appropriate error message and does not create resource.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 and PT27 to create active citizen account
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates input validation for report classification.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a technical office staff member I want to update report statuses So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
strategy_items.prompt: Retrieve list of reports assigned to technical office staff. Verify response includes status updates from external maintainers (from PT25) and filtering by assignment role works correctly.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Assign report via PT24 and update status via PT25
strategy_items.rationale: Validates role-based data visibility and status propagation.
